mainEntity.name: What does this IQ test measure?

acceptedAnswer.text: This assessment measures fluid intelligence (Gf) across four cognitive domains: verbal reasoning, numerical reasoning, logical deduction, and spatial visualization. It uses 16 original items calibrated with Item Response Theory to estimate your cognitive ability.

Your responses are scored server-side using a Three-Parameter Logistic (3PL) Item Response Theory model. This accounts for item difficulty, discrimination, and guessing probability to produce a calibrated ability estimate, which is then converted to a standard IQ scale (mean 100, standard deviation 15).

mainEntity.name: Is this a clinical IQ test?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. This is not a clinical or professionally validated IQ assessment. It should not be used for diagnostic, employment, educational placement, or legal purposes. It is designed as an accessible cognitive self-assessment tool for personal insight and curiosity.

Your data is stored securely in an encrypted database accessible only via server-side service keys. We comply with PIPEDA and CASL regulations. Consent records are retained for a minimum of 3 years. You can request data deletion at any time by contacting us.
